title: Learning Graph Viewer
description: An interactive visualization tool for exploring the AI Based Data Science with Python learning graph.
subject: Mathematics
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Locate a data science concept in the learning graph using type-ahead search and identify its taxonomy category
Trace directed dependency edges to determine which prerequisite concepts must be learned before an advanced topic like machine learning
Filter the graph by taxonomy categories (Python programming, statistical analysis, machine learning, NLP, generative AI) to isolate one topic area
Interpret the visible node, edge, and orphan counts in the statistics panel as category filters change
Plan a personal learning path from foundational concepts through Python libraries to a chosen specialization using the dependency structure
